summary: Separated normal npm test coverage from flow-local spec-local coverage for R4.

items.title: R4 conflicts with the existing npm test boundary for spec-local tests
items.rationale: R4 now requires shared tests under `tests/unit` or `tests/e2e` for normal npm test detection, while spec-local tests remain flow-local requirement coverage.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements[3].desc and acceptance_criteria[3] now separate shared npm-test coverage from spec-local coverage.
